name: Clippy: Clipboard History
subtitle: Copy once. Find it whenever.
promotionalText: Your clipboard, with a memory. Find copied text and images in a moment. Free, open source, and no account required.
description:
Clippy remembers what you copy so you can find it when you need it.

Open your clipboard history from the menu bar or with a keyboard shortcut. Search copied text, reuse images, and keep your work moving.

• Search your recent copies
• Keep history on your Mac
• Choose your own shortcuts
• Start with one optional welcome screen
• No Clippy account or subscription

Clippy is free and open source. Optional text AI lets you use your OpenAI API key or connect your ChatGPT account. API charges or ChatGPT plan limits apply. Clipboard history needs neither. No voice recording.

Select an item, then press Command-V to paste it into your app.
reviewNotes: Clipboard history needs no login. Launch Clippy from the menu bar, copy sample text, press Command-Shift-V, select it, then paste with Command-V. Ask Clippy opens an optional text panel. Settings offers an OpenAI API key or ChatGPT sign-in through the bundled Codex helper. Both require the reviewer’s own provider access. The helper inherits the app sandbox and disables tools. No microphone access, Gemini, or Sparkle is included in this Store build. Validate and provide review access before submitting.
